description: Build a multilingual AST code graph in SQLite without embedding/vector services: JS/TS compiler resolution plus bundled Tree-sitter profiles for Python, PHP, Go, Java, C/C++, C#, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, Swift, Scala and Lua. Reports syntax recovery/coverage warnings. Dynamic/external/ambiguous relationships may be unresolved. Honors scanner exclusions and .hnindexignore. Re-run after upgrading or changing source.
name: index_code_graph
